subject: reasoning
question: Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d7457e4c3423c551846fd01a7d9647e9992b23832ed02d87289cd338696eaf2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85bef136621f2cdb6e794c13c3321610ffdc60c2148c4055f6bbcb38d9ab295b.png] 

The bottom and 1st column elements interchange positions.

The rest of the positions shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bbb7cf440b36bb85581203d97ae5a4f718cc459d9f7710a7be38c0a5e676121.png] 

2) Second box series →

The top and 3rd column elements interchange positions.

The rest of the positions shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204fda76586d5468503cb26f36499293485501506539c06da1223f9488abdb62.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb652b0df82a0c0f9c59c520abc166af989bab21fd12f3fbb25a963e073875ad.png] 

Hence, "**Option 3**" is the correct answer.
